steps.hr: Motor: otvoreni Mixxx 2.5.6 prenesen u projekt. Na računalu prolazi svih 851 testova.
steps.en: Engine: the open source Mixxx 2.5.6 brought into the project. All 851 of its tests pass on desktop.

steps.hr: Sve biblioteke za zvuk i analizu (18 njih) prevedene za Android, za mobitele i emulator.
steps.en: All 18 sound and analysis libraries cross-compiled for Android, for phones and the emulator.

steps.hr: Prvi Android build: aplikacija se gradi u APK za emulator (90 MB). Sljedeće: pokretanje na Pixelu 7.
steps.en: First Android build: the app now builds into an APK for the emulator (90 MB). Next: launching it on a Pixel 7.

steps.hr: Aplikacija se pokreće na Androidu: zove se DJ Mantra i ima svoju ikonu (dvije valne linije u bojama dijelova pjesme), skinovi i mapiranja su u APK-u, nema dijaloga koji zaustavlja pokretanje, a svaka nova verzija se prvo sama pokrene na emulatoru (test pokretanja). Čeka test na telefonu.
steps.en: The app starts on Android: it is called DJ Mantra and has its own icon (two waveforms in song-section colors), skins and mappings are inside the APK, no dialog stops the start, and every new build first starts itself on an emulator (launch test). Waiting for the phone test.

steps.hr: Video datoteke kao pjesme: MP4, MKV, WebM i drugi sviraju svoj zvuk, a prvi kadar videa postaje omot.
steps.en: Video files as tracks: MP4, MKV, WebM and others play their audio, and the first frame of the video becomes the cover.

steps.hr: Izvoz pjesama koje nedostaju: tekstualna datoteka s poveznicom na svaku pjesmu (TIDAL, Bandcamp, Beatport, Qobuz).
steps.en: Missing songs export: a text file with a link to every song (TIDAL, Bandcamp, Beatport, Qobuz).

steps.hr: Biblioteka: ocjena ★ 1–5 (klik povećava), stupac "Export" s kvačicama i izvoz označenih pjesama kao popis s poveznicama; sortiranje po bilo kojem stupcu, inače ručni redoslijed playliste.
steps.en: Library: ★ 1–5 rating (each click raises it), an "Export" column with tick marks and export of the marked songs as a list with links; sort by any column, otherwise the playlist's manual order.

steps.hr: Vanjski diskovi (USB stick, USB disk, SD kartica): Android-ov odabir mape na disku, pjesma se prije sviranja kopira u memoriju mobitela, pa izvlačenje diska ne prekida glazbu; pjesme s izvađenog diska ostaju u biblioteci.
steps.en: External drives (USB stick, USB disk, SD card): Android's folder picker on the drive, a song is copied to the phone's memory before it plays, so pulling the drive out does not stop the music; songs on an unplugged drive stay in the library.

steps.hr: Mape kao u djayu: "+" doda mapu, ona i sve podmape pojave se u stablu i svaka radi kao playlista; mapa ostaje zauvijek, a pjesme su označene online (zeleno) ili offline (crveno) ovisno o tome je li disk spojen.
steps.en: Folders like in djay: "+" adds a folder, it and all its subfolders appear in a tree and each one works like a playlist; a folder stays for good, and songs are marked online (green) or offline (red) depending on whether the drive is connected.

steps.hr: TIDAL: prijava, moje playliste u aplikaciji, pjesme povezane s mojim datotekama. Razvojna aplikacija registrirana.
steps.en: TIDAL: log in, my playlists in the app, songs matched to my own files. Developer app registered.

steps.hr: Zvuk na mobitelu (Oboe): dva izlaza odjednom, Bluetooth zvučnik i USB slušalice, s kašnjenjem za sinkronizaciju.
steps.en: Sound on the phone (Oboe): two outputs at once, Bluetooth speaker and USB headphones, with delay to keep them in sync.

steps.hr: Hercules DJControl Mix Ultra: cijeli kontroler snimljen i mapiran (svaka tipka, SHIFT, padovi u 8 načina, LED-ice), spajanje preko USB-C i Bluetootha bez uparivanja; čeka test na mobitelu.
steps.en: Hercules DJControl Mix Ultra: the whole controller captured and mapped (every button, SHIFT, pads in 8 modes, LEDs), connecting over USB-C and Bluetooth without pairing; waiting for the phone test.

steps.hr: Svjetla takta kao u djayu: padovi na kontroleru pokazuju takt 1–8 fraze u svakom načinu rada, za poravnanje dviju pjesama "1 na 1"; pad skače na taj takt.
steps.en: Beat lights like djay's: the controller's pads show beat 1–8 of the phrase in every mode, to align two songs "1 with 1"; a pad jumps to that beat.

steps.hr: Dijelovi pjesme u boji: intro, build-up, drop, breakdown, verse, outro, prepoznati na samom mobitelu.
steps.en: Song sections in color: intro, build-up, drop, breakdown, verse, outro, detected on the phone itself.

steps.hr: Žanrovi što detaljnije (MusicBrainz, TIDAL) i pretraga TIDAL-a po žanru, poredana po popularnosti.
steps.en: Genres in as much detail as possible (MusicBrainz, TIDAL), and a TIDAL search by genre, sorted by popularity.

steps.hr: Pametni žanrovi i noćna analiza cijele biblioteke: BPM, beat grid, tonalitet, valni oblik i žanr za sve pjesme odjednom.
steps.en: Smart genres and overnight analysis of the whole library: BPM, beat grid, key, waveform and genre for every song at once.

steps.hr: Sučelje za dodir: dva decka, valni oblici, mikser i padovi; preko cijelog ekrana prikaz samo valnih oblika (deck 1 gore, deck 2 dolje) i prikaz samo biblioteke.
steps.en: Touch interface: two decks, waveforms, mixer and pads; a full-screen waveform view (deck 1 on top, deck 2 below) and a full-screen library view.

steps.hr: Prva verzija za preuzimanje (APK) za druge DJ-eve.
steps.en: First version to download (APK) for other DJs.
